scope: mGBA 0.10.5 source-only Timer 0 co-due scheduler and Direct Sound ownership audit

scheduler.dueRule: mTimingTick dispatches the root while next->when - masterCycles <= 0 and passes cyclesLate = -(next->when - masterCycles)
scheduler.insertRule: mTimingSchedule walks past an existing event unless its due time is later or its equal-time priority is numerically greater than the new event
scheduler.equalTimeRule: lower numeric priority runs first; equal priority retains existing insertion order
scheduler.callbackCostRule: mTimingTick advances masterCycles only by its cycles argument; callbacks do not receive an automatic emulated-cycle charge
scheduler.sameDueDispatchRule: a callback-scheduled due event is reinserted into the root and is consumed by the same mTimingTick due loop

video.callbackScheduling: _startHdraw schedules the next Hblank before scanline/VBlank work; _startHblank schedules the next Hdraw before renderer and DMA work, both with -cyclesLate
coDuePayload: Hblank, Vblank, or display-start DMA request when its source condition is active
frame hooks and earlyExit at VBlank

audioSample.callbackScheduling: _sample samples at mTimingCurrentTime - cyclesLate, then schedules SAMPLE_INTERVAL - cyclesLate
audioSample.directSoundRelation: the GBA Audio Sample callback mixes current FIFO samples but does not call GBAAudioSampleFIFO; Timer 0 owns FIFO word consumption/refill requests

callbackOrder: reschedule normal timer from currentTime minus cyclesLate
raise timer IRQ only if its IRQ flag is set
timer0.callbackScheduling: GBATimerUpdateRegister uses currentTime = mTimingCurrentTime - cyclesLate and schedules the next absolute overflow
coDueOrderWithDefaultEvents: GBA IRQ Event if already due (priority 0)
emeraldAudioRoutes: FIFO A: Timer 0, right output, DMA1
FIFO B: Timer 0, left output, DMA2

directSoundDma.fifoDmaStartRule: GBAAudioSampleFIFO writes dma.when = mTimingCurrentTime - cyclesLate before GBADMASchedule; the +3 start delay is only GBADMA TIMING NOW
directSoundDma.forcedTransfer: FIFO scheduling forces fixed destination and 32-bit width
directSoundDma.activeSelection: GBADMAUpdate scans DMA0 through DMA3 and retains the first channel on equal dma.when - currentTime; a strictly earlier deadline replaces it
directSoundDma.sameDueDmaOrder: DMA1 wins a same-time DMA1/DMA2 selection because the scan is ascending and compares with <
directSoundDma.serviceOwnership: GBADMAService owns cpuBlocked, per-word waitstate progression, overdue-DMA deadline coalescing, and terminal completion adjustment

preconditions: one enabled custom DMA1 or DMA2 has count == nextCount == 4
mGBA waitstate tables are the pinned 0.10.5 defaults

reductionBoundary.independentUnit: the stateful DMA service graph rooted by Timer 0 FIFO A/B requests
requires: FIFO read/write and internalRemaining for A and B at the Timer 0 overflow
DMA1/DMA2 enable, count, nextCount, when, source, destination, and register timing
cyclesLate and the exact current mTiming time
pre-existing DMA deadlines and any DMA started by the co-due Video callback
whether GBA audio mixer state is null or requires its source-inspection side effect
mustRemainExternal: GBA Video callback ordering and renderer/frame hooks
GBA Audio Sample callback mixing and its own 1024-cycle event cadence
IRQ scheduling/dispatch and CPU interrupt state
pre-existing or co-due DMA arbitration and CPU blocking
reductionBoundary.negativeBoundary: No source-closed Timer 0 serviceCostMasterCycles exists: mTimingTick does not charge callbacks, while FIFO sampling may enqueue zero, one, or two DMA requests and GBADMAService charges state-dependent progression. Do not wire a fixed callback cost or fit an observed edge total from this audit.
reductionBoundary.nextObservable: A fresh OFF runtime receipt must capture one Timer 0 overflow with event due times/priority order plus FIFO A/B pointers, internalRemaining, DMA1/2 registers/deadlines, activeDMA, cyclesLate, and any Video/Audio/IRQ events due in the same window.
